_readme: Selectors and URLs of my.soliq.uz pages BEHIND the login. Every section is filled only from what the discovery run (npm run discover) actually observed in a signed-in browser; a section that is null was NOT observed and makes the agent stop with a precise message when it is needed. Nothing here is guessed.

observed.2026-10-24: Individual (jismoniy shaxs) cabinet, 40 pages read-only. Identity element, individual declaration service, menu structure.
observed.2026-10-24 (e-reporting): Reporting system oldmy.soliq.uz/wefo4-clientui reached by clicking the service card on my.soliq.uz/with-sidebar/services. Journal, report view, confirmation page, catalog, blank form of 10190_14. Individual (jismoniy shaxs) cabinet only.
observed.2026-10-24 (turnover form): Form 10190_14 read with period September chosen: lines 010 020 030 040 050 060 070 0701 080 and appendix 0101-0105 are filled by the cabinet.
observed.2026-10-24 (entrepreneur cabinet): ЯТТнинг шахсий кабинети (header switch "Ўтиш"): payment form with tax types 38/47/100/199, personal tax card (KLS) per tax, letters (requirements/notices), reporting card "ЯТТларнинг солиқ ҳисоботларини юбориш" (user_type=3).

individual_annual_income_declaration.title_uz: Жисмоний шахснинг жами йиллик даромадлари тўғрисидаги декларация
individual_annual_income_declaration.note: The only declaration this individual cabinet offers. It is NOT one of Bugalter's report types (VAT, turnover, profit, payroll): Bugalter holds no personal-income data for it.

company_reports.entry: Redirect to https://oldmy.soliq.uz (wefo4-clientui). A different application on another host; NOT observed yet because an individual key does not reach it.

wefo.note: Observed 2026-10-24 (read only, nothing saved): choosing tax 100, kind 1, year and period M_n makes the cabinet fill the sheets itself. The send flow (E-IMZO dialog, result) was NOT observed.
